cohort: Pregnant women at ≥34 weeks of gestation with a history of one previous lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) and singleton pregnancy in cephalic presentation.
finding: Trial of labor is a reasonable option for appropriately selected pregnant women with one prior LSCS, with a vaginal birth rate of 40.9% in the trial of labor group.
mod_finding: Among those attempting trial of labor after previous cesarean, the most common indication for emergency cesarean section was scar tenderness (46.2%) followed by non-progress of labor (34.6%).
